contracts.name: Agent Skills specification
assumptions: A skill is a directory containing SKILL.md.
The portable frontmatter contract includes name and description.

contracts.name: Codex skill discovery

contracts.name: Omarchy Quattro shell contract
assumptions: Quattro plugins use a root manifest.json and hosted QML entry points.
Third-party plugin code executes inside the long-running shell process.
Reviewed 2026-09-29: third-party entry points receive capability-scoped facades and detached configuration snapshots, not trusted host objects; these are not same-process QML sandboxes.
Service-backed third-party widgets retain full own-service integration under the trusted built-in bar; replacement bars provide service-less entry facades.
keepLoaded services survive plugin hot-reload and require a shell restart for code changes.
Reviewed 2026-11-08; see docs/reviews/2026-11-08-host-refresh.md for changes and evidence limits.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace submission form
assumptions: Tags use form display labels; preserve exact headings and five acknowledgments.

contracts.name: Omarchy marketplace security review semantics
assumptions: New listing/update selective disposition may accept exact non-blocking findings; existing-snapshot maintainer-verified remains capability-only.

contracts.name: Omarchy shell motion contract
assumptions: Use Style.duration for animation durations and stop loops under Style.reduceMotion.
Prefer host panel/popup/button motion and verify interrupted transitions on the target host.

contracts.name: Omarchy supervised shell launcher
assumptions: Shell logs use the omarchy-shell journal tag.

contracts.name: Omarchy shell restart recovery
assumptions: Use the supported restart command with existing authorization; respect active session-lock protection.
IPC readiness alone does not establish notification-service or lock recovery.
